headline.text: 35 VC-backed companies in your thesis raised since 2022 and never hit your CRM

patterns.text: 18 of the 35 raised a seed round

insights.title: A sourcing gap in the Nordics
insights.line: Lifeline Ventures and Innovestor backed 8 of 35; you never co-invested with them.

insights.title: AI software for industrial workflows
insights.line: They sell AI tools to engineering, maintenance and field teams in industrial companies.

insights.title: Already raising again
insights.line: 12 of 35 have closed a further round since; they are moving fast.
